turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: awaiting item: tracking can take a bit to start moving. If there’s no update within 7 days of the label being created, we’ll need to look into it. - If it’s in transit and the ETA has passed: it may still arrive within a few extra days. - If it’s been over 2 weeks in transit: it may be lost in transit and we’ll need to investigate. You can check your tracking status here If you share your order number (and what the tracking currently says), I can tell you the right next step for your situation.
